name: chief-of-staff
triggers: any request; daily brief; weekly review; drift check

name: reviewer
inputs: the handoff file; files its Result points to
outputs: Review section; Status: reviewed or rework

name: marketing-writer
triggers: email; post; ad copy; landing page copy

name: marketing-analyst
triggers: what's working; campaign numbers; content performance
inputs: exports or connector data named in the handoff
outputs: numbers and one recommendation in Result

name: sales-researcher
triggers: find leads; win-back list; research a prospect
inputs: brain/clients.md; brain/offers.md; sources named in the handoff
outputs: list with a source per row in Result

name: sales-followup
inputs: brain/offers.md; brain/voice.md; the thread or notes in the handoff

name: ops-triage
triggers: sort my inbox; what's urgent; clean up this list
inputs: the files or exports named in the handoff
outputs: sorted list with one action each in Result

name: ops-sop-writer
triggers: write a process; checklist; how we do X
inputs: the owner's notes in the handoff
outputs: SOP saved to brain/sops/ and linked in Result
